SOOPPIY DOCS — TRADING GATEWAY SETUP

Connect Alpaca

How to create the API credentials at Alpaca and connect them on the Accounts page. live trading available

1What you need

  • API key
  • API secret
Grant TRADE permission only — never withdrawal. Use the venue's IP allowlist when it offers one. Start small. Your keys are encrypted at rest (AES-GCM) on Sooppiy's server and are never shown again after you save them.

2Create your credentials at Alpaca

  1. Log in at app.alpaca.markets and open the dashboard for the account you want to connect.
  2. Generate the key pair from API Keys on the right-hand panel. The secret is shown once.
  3. Paper and live are separate accounts with separate keys: paper keys only work against the paper environment, live keys only against live. Use paper keys while you run shadow; replace them with live keys when you go live.

3Connect it on the Accounts page

  1. Open Accounts → Trading gateway.
  2. Pick your region (ordering only — every broker stays available) and choose Alpaca.
  3. Paste the credentials from step 2.
  4. Read and accept the live-trading terms — required even if you only plan to use shadow.
  5. Press Connect gateway. The account starts in paper mode: nothing is sent to Alpaca yet.
  6. Switch the account to shadow (recommended first) or live on the account card.

4What each mode does with Alpaca

ModeWhat happens
paperpaper / simulator — every trade stays on Sooppiy's internal ledger. Alpaca is never contacted.
shadowshadow — fills stay simulated and the same order is ALSO sent to Alpaca's paper trading environment for comparison; the drift is journalled. This needs paper-account keys.
livelive — real orders go to your Alpaca account. The broker is authoritative: a rejected order never creates a platform position. Requires accepted terms and usable credentials; refusals are always explicit, never a silent simulation.
Whatever mode you use, the Broker orders and Drift records panels at the bottom of the Accounts page show what Alpaca actually confirmed next to what the ledger assumed — differences are surfaced loudly, never auto-corrected.

5Venue notes

  • US stocks and ETFs; orders route during US market sessions.
  • Alpaca availability depends on your country of residence — check Alpaca's own supported-country list when opening the account.

6Troubleshooting

SymptomWhat it means / what to do
“credentials are missing or cannot be decrypted”The stored key can no longer be read (for example after a server key rotation). Reconnect the broker with fresh credentials.
“live-trading terms have not been accepted”Accept the terms for this broker on the Accounts page — consent is recorded per broker.
“forbidden” / 403 on every orderAlmost always paper keys against the live environment or the reverse. Match the key pair to the mode you are in.
